title: NEVER add these to your resume...
description:
Recruiters look at your resume for a typical max of 10 seconds so ANY place where there’s resistance isn’t good. Bubble charts and skill sliders can seem like a good idea to add flair to your resume but all they actually do is create confusion. Your resume is all about showing impact so instead of saying you have a skill in a chart SHOW it with an awesome achievement. #resumebuilder #resumetips #resume #resumetok #resumebullets
